_comment: Ratchet, not a cap you can raise. A skill ABSENT from `grandfathered` must have a
body at or under `limitBytes`. A skill LISTED here must stay at or under its recorded
size: it may shrink, never grow. When it reaches limitBytes, delete its entry.
Entries are never added - a new skill over budget is a build failure, not a new row.
Body excludes YAML frontmatter, measured exactly as validate-skills.yml measures it.
limitBytes is clud-bug's DEFAULT_MAX_SKILL_BYTES (prompt-builder.ts), which its own
comment ties to SPEC 1.10. Note its shipped workflow templates override this DOWN to
4000; a repo using an unmodified template truncates earlier than this budget allows.
Over budget? The remedy is to write tighter or split the skill - NOT to move prose
into references/. Verified against clud-bug src/ and templates/: nothing reads a
and nothing else, so for that consumer moving content to references/ is deletion,
not deferral. Progressive disclosure works for an interactive agent; it does not
work here, and this file must not pretend otherwise.
